exposure.needed: which Prometheus dashboards, alerting rules, or PromQL queries reference the old metric name lbipam_conflicting_pools_total

consequence.statement: The metric is only exposed under the new name lbipam_conflicting_pools, so dashboards, alerts, or queries still referencing lbipam_conflicting_pools_total will stop receiving data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerting rules, and PromQL queries to use lbipam_conflicting_pools instead of lbipam_conflicting_pools_total.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Prometheus metric lbipam_conflicting_pools_total has been renamed to lbipam_conflicting_pools.
